author: Millienda
body: I'd say the penguin has better buffing rates (4 vs 3), but the phoenix has protect chance which penguin doesn't. So if you're only really after deific channel, I'd go penguin, if the protect can help you, go phoenix ?

author: Daelune__
body: Idk what Orna math is either, but can we assume that 4 buff rate is better than 3 come on bro. Anyways. When it comes to endless where you want that buff more often, sure you can go with the penguin, but there’s plenty of players that prefer Phoenix still considering it has the protect chance, which can be a life saver. That paired with Jord, it can be super useful. And before I get people coming at me with “yOuRe sUpPosEd tO uSe bRyN”, I know players that make it past 500-600 floors with Jord instead of Bryn. (I still prefer Bryn lol). In summary, Penguin for buffs, Phoenix for endless. Still would never use either in any content other than endless tho. 🤢

author: Jeronetj3
body:
As a heretic, Penguin is primarily attack based so the Phoenix makes a bit more sense since you wouldn’t need to also buff up with attack up and such     
But if you are a crit based heretic and get the level 1 bestial bond through spec or gear the Penguin could give you a little boost (if you haven’t maxed out crit chance yet, else it’s only the damage)
